thread:
alex: Quick heads-up — dry run with HW SI + Datadog tomorrow 10:00am PT to validate telemetry for private GPU inference (air-gapped demo). Please join if you touch tracing/metrics/dashboards.
maria: Are we running the OTLP file sink flow again? last-minute config we had for airgap right?
jamie: Yep — otelcol sidecar writing to local file, then an offline forwarder to Datadog. I pushed the collector config to the demo branch: \n```
receivers:
  otlp:
    protocols:
      grpc: {}
exporters:
  file:
    path: /var/log/otel/out.json
service:
  pipelines:
    traces:
      receivers: [otlp]
      exporters: [file]
```
cheng: For the demo, we should also show traces + metrics correlation. Proposal: emit a metric for kv_cache.hit with labels {model, shard, batch_size} and a trace attribute `redwood.kv_cached=true` on the request span so Datadog can link them.
alex: Good call. Also need span naming conventions so partner teams can map requests across services. Suggest: `redwood.inference.request` root span, child spans: `runtime.kv_lookup`, `runtime.attention`, `runtime.token_emit`.
maria: What about sampling? We can't send full traces for every token. Suggest 1:100 default, 1:1 for error paths and tail-latency traces (>= 200ms). Can implement sampler in otelcol config and a post-filter in forwarder.
jamie: I'll wire sampler rules. Also will include a demo script that forces a 300ms tail-latency by running a slow attention kernel to show tail-trace capture.
dd-integration-bot: Reminder: Datadog requires `service.name` and `resource.name` populated for trace ingestion. Missing fields will be dropped by intake. Also recommend adding `env` and `redwood_tier` tags for dashboard filters.
cheng: For dashboards — we should build a small tile pack: 1) p50/p95/p99 token latency by model, 2) kv_cache hit rate heatmap, 3) trace waterfall example with span durations annotated, 4) errors by span type.
alex: Can we include a demo dashboard JSON export ready to import into Datadog? If so, partner PM can import pre-demo.
maria: I can make a lightweight importable dashboard (no secrets). Will include widgets for trace search query example: `service:redwood-inference env:staging redwood.kv_cached:true`.
jamie: Ops note — the forwarder needs credentials injected at the post-demo step. For the dry-run we'll stub the forwarder and use a local dd-agent mimic. Will document the credential flow for SI.
cheng: Also callout for release comms: we need a short blurb for partner announcement if the demo is green. Draft: "Redwood + Datadog: out-of-the-box telemetry for private inference — traces, metrics, and prebuilt dashboards for GPU-backed workloads." Keep it high-level.
alex: Nice. Who owns what: - Alex: run demo + coord with SI = tomorrow 10am PT - Jamie: otelcol + sampler + demo script = PR in demo branch by EOD - Maria: dashboard JSON + trace queries = PR by EOD - Cheng: prepare slide with span naming + metric schema + announcement blurb
maria: I'll also record a 5-min walkthrough (loom) after the run; useful for partner onboarding.
ajamie: tiny correction — my branch name is `demo/dd-airgap-2812`, linking in the thread.
alex: perfect. If anything blocks, @maria or @jamie ping me. see you all at 10am :rocket:
